pages.title: Argali
pages.text: The argali ($(o)Ovis ammon$()) is the largest wild sheep, found in the mountains and high steppes of Central Asia.$(br2)Rams carry enormous spiralling horns that can weigh as much as the rest of their skeleton.$(br2)Argali live in herds and rely on keen eyesight and speed to escape wolves and snow leopards.
